title: Tir de harpon

Conditional traction after a successful shot: ordinary mobile enemy 100%, mobile elite 75%; bosses and anchored targets do not move, attack damage preserved. Unshown full curves, exact path/roll order, classification and native rendering remain pending.
accepted_conditions: Target visible and shot path clear.
Obstacles and occupied cells stop traction.
Bosses and anchored targets do not move, shot damage remains applicable.
Equipped and active ordinary ranged weapon; heavy weapons excluded.
general_control_rule_approval: Existing CTRL01 retained; DI05 conditional baseline and displayed 100/75% application accepted.
unshown_rules_approval: Full curves, exact pull path/ties/diagonals, anchored target taxonomy, success draw order and extra elite roll timing, ordinary shot hit/defense/critical resolution, supported ordinary weapon families, damage distribution, resource refusal/payment, affix and attribute stacking remain pending where not already accepted. No shared STR/INT control formula, status duration, or Repousser collision damage invented.
